bio: In the restaurant of the grand Hotel Stadthaus, whichever one of the different rooms you are seated in, the same delicious cuisine is on the menu – from Swiss classics, such as Zürcher Geschnetzeltes, to vegetarian dishes and a set Bistro Menu. There is also an ambitious Gourmet Menu on Thu-Sat evenings. The selection of wines by the glass and by the bottle is also impressive. In summer, you can enjoy your meal on the arcaded terrace at the entrance....
